svg.title: snakemake-hydra modular NGS pipeline overview
svg.desc: Curated overview of the RNA-seq, WGBS, ChIP-seq/CUT&RUN, and ATAC-seq subpipelines, including shared intake, selected workflow dispatch, pipeline-specific analysis steps, optional QC, and MultiQC reporting.
svg.text: One Snakemake entrypoint dispatches to RNA-seq, WGBS, ChIP-seq/CUT&RUN, or ATAC-seq; shared QC, config helpers, and MultiQC reporting connect the modules.
Rules exposed as rnaseq_*, wgbs_*, chip_cr_*, atacseq_*
MultiQC waits on config-aware input files
Analysis dirs include results and logs
PE only; transcript quantification, genomic alignment, QC, tracks
PE only; bisulfite alignment, filtering, methylation extraction
PE and SE; enrichment QC, bigWigs, input subtraction, heatmap
PE only; open chromatin QC, tracks, configurable peak calling
HISAT2 summary files are tracked for MultiQC
Picard MarkDuplicates marks duplicates, does not remove them
abundance.tsv, sorted BAM/BAM index, markdup metrics
bigWig, optional correlation and gene-body plots
Bismark PE alignment uses stable _pe BAM/report names
deduplicate_bismark writes deduplicated BAM and report
samtools stats and flagstat on deduplicated BAM
Sambamba sort and samtools index filtered BAM
Filtered sorted BAM/index, BAM QC, M-bias TSV
MultiQC scans WGBS results plus configurable wgbs.log_dir
PE and SE supported; missing type inferred from reads
Bowtie2 index build plus PE/SE sorted BAM outputs
Sambamba markdup, view filter, and sort pipeline
Filtered BAM QC mirrors aligned BAM QC
Uses subtracted bigWig when available; excludes input samples
Filtered BAMs, BAM QC, fingerprints, heatmap
Bowtie2 index sentinel in configured index directory
PE Bowtie2 alignment to sorted BAM
Sambamba removes duplicate-marked reads and filters BAM
Filtered sorted BAM drives downstream outputs
Filtered BAM/index, duplicate metrics, fragment QC
Peak caller must be macs3 or genrich
Each workflow builds multiqc_input_files and multiqc_analysis_dirs, then writes <multiqc_results_dir>/multiqc_report.html.
Only the selected pipeline is imported for execution, but this diagram documents all subpipelines currently implemented in the repository.
